architectureDecision.summary: Path1 P1-01/P1-02 keep their arithmetic KnowledgePoint identity and operand envelope, while semantic relation and language surfaces are reused from the already production-promoted G3B-U08 equal-groups authority.
reasons: A05 registries remain shadow-pilot only with zero production admissions.
The A05 validator explicitly rejects production-admitted bindings inside that pilot contract.
G3B-U08 equal-groups PatternSpecs already have production promotion, blocking validation, worksheet eligibility, public selector/print QA, and human semantic readback evidence.
P1-12 already consumes the same equal-groups canonical relation authority, so reusing it avoids a parallel word-problem semantics system.

semanticSurfaceAdmission.admissionRule: Every Path1 transfer surface must be present in the G3B-U08 equal-groups PatternGroup and in the S58F production promotion registry at implementation time.

dualLineageContract.relationKnowledgePointMetadataMeaning: semantic relation used to construct the equation
invariants: source lineage records both g3a_u03_3a03 and g3b_u08_3b08

operandAuthority.P1-02_twoDigit: amountPerGroup 10..99; groupCount 2..9; existing ones-column carry guard retained
operandAuthority.P1-02_threeDigit: amountPerGroup 100..999; groupCount 2..9; existing zero-special exclusions retained; product <=999
operandAuthority.P1-02_distribution: balanced across the two canonical arithmetic KnowledgePoints subject to requested count and available distinct capacity

futureGeneratorContract.semanticSurfaceSource: Import existing G3B-U08 PatternSpec definitions and context variants; do not copy or invent a new semantic corpus.
futureGeneratorContract.renderingRule: Render the selected approved PatternSpec/context variant with Path1-owned amountPerGroup and groupCount values; add only the fixed instructional suffix asking the learner to write an equation before answering.
futureGeneratorContract.answerTextContract: include equation witness plus semantic answer with unit
